references.text: Here God demonstrates his power over Egypt through Moses, as a parallel to Jesus' power over demons.
Peter speaks of how God anointed Jesus, and he went around healing all who were oppressed by the devil, showing God's kingdom through Jesus' actions.
Jesus mentions how demons are driven out by the finger of God, indicating the presence of God's kingdom.
Jesus proclaims all authority in heaven and on earth, underscoring his authority over demons.
